options.name: backup
options.description: Create a backup of the existing configuration file before overwriting. The backup file is created in the same directory with a timestamp suffix.

options.name: compress
options.description: Compress rotated log files.

options.name: compress_options
options.description: Options to pass to compression program. For O(compression_method=gzip), use V(-9) for best compression, V(-1) for fastest. For O(compression_method=xz), use V(-9) for best compression.

options.name: compression_method
options.description: Compression method to use. Requires logrotate 3.18.0 or later for V(xz) and V(zstd).

options.name: config_dir
options.description: Directory where logrotate configurations are stored. Using V(~/.logrotate.d) is recommended for user-specific configurations. This directory must exist before using the module.

options.name: copy
options.description: Copy the log file but do not truncate the original. Takes precedence over O(rename_copy) and O(copy_truncate).

options.name: copy_truncate
options.description: Copy the log file and then truncate it in place. Useful for applications that cannot be told to close their logfile.

options.name: create
options.description: Create new log file with specified permissions after rotation. Format is V(mode owner group) (for example V(0640 root adm)). Set to V(null) or omit to use V(nocreate).

options.name: create_old_dir
options.description: Create O(old_dir) directory if it does not exist.

options.name: date_ext
options.description: Use date as extension for rotated files (using the date format specified in O(date_format) instead of sequential numbers).

options.name: date_format
options.description: Format for date extension. Use with O(date_ext=true). Format specifiers are V(%Y) year, V(%m) month, V(%d) day, V(%s) seconds since epoch.

options.name: date_yesterday
options.description: Use yesterday's date for O(date_ext) instead of today's date. Useful for rotating logs that span midnight.

options.name: delay_compress
options.description: Postpone compression of the previous log file to the next rotation cycle. Useful for applications that keep writing to the old log file for some time.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the configuration should be enabled. When V(false), adds V(.disabled) extension to the config file.

options.name: extension
options.description: Extension to use for rotated log files (including dot). Useful when O(compress=false).

options.name: first_action
options.description: Commands to execute once before all log files that match the wildcard pattern are rotated.

options.name: include
options.description: Include additional configuration files from specified directory.

options.name: last_action
options.description: Commands to execute once after all log files that match the wildcard pattern are rotated.

options.name: mail
options.description: Mail logs to specified address when removed. Set to V(null) or omit to not mail logs.

options.name: mail_first
options.description: Mail just-created log file, not the about-to-expire one.

options.name: mail_last
options.description: Mail about-to-expire log file (default).

options.name: max_age
options.description: Remove rotated logs older than specified number of days.

options.name: max_size
options.description: Rotate log file when it grows bigger than specified size, but at most once per O(rotation_period). Format is V(number[k|M|G]) (for example V(100M), V(1G)).

options.name: min_size
options.description: Rotate log file only if it has grown bigger than specified size. Format is V(number[k|M|G]) (for example V(100M), V(1G)). Used with time-based rotation to avoid rotating too small files.

options.name: missing_ok
options.description: Do not issue an error if the log file is missing.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the logrotate configuration. This creates a file in O(config_dir) with this name.

options.name: no_delay_compress
options.description: Opposite of O(delay_compress). Ensure compression happens immediately. Note that in logrotate, V(no_delay_compress) is the default behavior.

options.name: no_old_dir
options.description: Keep rotated logs in the same directory as the original log.

options.name: not_if_empty
options.description: Do not rotate the log file if it is empty. Set to V(false) to rotate even empty log files (equivalent to C(ifempty) in logrotate).

options.name: old_dir
options.description: Move rotated logs into specified directory.

options.name: paths
options.description: List of log file paths or patterns to rotate. Can include wildcards (for example V(/var/log/app/*.log)). Required when creating a new configuration (O(state=present) and config file does not exist). Optional when modifying existing configuration (for example to enable/disable).

options.name: post_rotate
options.description: Commands to execute after rotating the log file. Can be a single string or list of commands.

options.name: pre_remove
options.description: Commands to execute before removing rotated log files.

options.name: pre_rotate
options.description: Commands to execute before rotating the log file. Can be a single string or list of commands.

options.name: rename_copy
options.description: Rename and copy the log file, leaving the original in place.

options.name: rotate_count
options.description: Number of rotated log files to keep. Set to V(0) to disable rotation (keep only current log). Set to V(-1) to keep all rotated logs (not recommended).

options.name: rotation_period
options.description: How often to rotate the logs. If not specified when modifying an existing configuration, the existing value is preserved. When creating a new configuration, this option is only included if specified. Choice V(hourly) was added in community.general 13.0.0.

options.name: shared_scripts
options.description: Run O(pre_rotate) and O(post_rotate) scripts only once for all matching log files.

options.name: shred
options.description: Use C(shred) to securely delete rotated log files. Uses C(shred -u) to overwrite files before deleting.

options.name: shred_cycles
options.description: Number of times to overwrite files when using O(shred=true). When omitted, logrotate uses C(shred)'s default.

options.name: size
options.description: Rotate log file when it grows bigger than specified size. Format is V(number[k|M|G]) (for example V(100M), V(1G)). Overrides O(rotation_period) when set. If not specified, existing value be preserved when modifying configuration. When creating new configuration, this option be omitted if not specified.

options.name: start
options.description: Base number for rotated files. Allowed values are from V(0) to V(999). For example, V(1) gives files C(.1), C(.2), and so on instead of C(.0), C(.1).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the configuration should be present or absent.

options.name: su
options.description: Set user and group for rotated files. Format is V(user group) (for example, V(www-data adm)). Set to V("") (empty string) to remove the directive from existing configurations. Set to V(null) or omit to leave the existing value unchanged (when modifying) or not set (when creating).

options.name: syslog
options.description: Send logrotate messages to syslog.

options.name: taboo_ext
options.description: List of extensions that logrotate should not touch. Set to V(null) or empty list to clear defaults.
